title: 第007章 三针废去横行臂第008章 城主悬赏满城沸
lines: 回到山林木屋时，已是午后。木屋里很安静，阿萝躺在干草铺上，似乎睡着了，但秦夜推门的轻微声响立刻让她睁开了眼睛，眼神警惕，直到看清是秦夜，才放松下来，露出一丝不易察觉的安心。
“秦大哥，你回来了。”她想撑起身子。
“躺着别动。”秦夜将手里的包子和水囊递过去，“先吃点东西，热的。”
阿萝接过，小口咬着还带着余温的包子，眼睛却一直看着秦夜，似乎想从他脸上看出些什么。
秦夜在她旁边坐下，也拿了个包子吃着，一边吃一边说：“我打听到了一些消息。关于那个刀疤刘，还有城主府的事。”
阿萝咀嚼的动作立刻停住，眼睛死死盯着秦夜。
“刀疤刘，本名刘三，淬体四重，城主府护卫队第三小队队长，是赵刚的心腹，也是他手下几条最凶的狗之一。”秦夜语气平淡，像是在叙述一件与己无关的事情，“今天中午，他和城主府一个主簿的儿子王振，还有几个纨绔，在百花楼喝酒。”
阿萝的手微微颤抖，包子差点掉下来。百花楼，那是她这种贫家女想都不敢想的销金窟。而害死她爹的仇人，就在那里花天酒地。
“我给他下了点小玩意，让他难受了一阵。”秦夜继续道，“顺便，也听他们说了些话。苏清雪陷害我，确实是为了退紫阳宗少宗主的婚，嫌那少宗主风流。但她选错了垫脚石，那少宗主觉得她用这种下作手段，连累他也丢了面子，对苏家颇为不满。”
阿萝听得有些茫然，这些高门大户之间的龃龉，离她太远。她只关心一点：“那……那刀疤刘……”
“他今晚不当值，按那些纨绔的说法，他喜欢去城西的‘快活林’赌两把，再找暗娼过夜。”秦夜吃完最后一口包子，擦了擦手，“快活林鱼龙混杂，是城里下九流聚集的地方，也是他这种人觉得最自在的场所。”
阿萝的心脏猛地一跳，呼吸急促起来：“秦大哥，你……你要去找他？”
“嗯。”秦夜点头，看着她，“阿萝，记住，报仇不是凭一时血气。要找准时机，用对方法。刀疤刘是城主府的人，在青云城有靠山，明目张胆杀他，会惹来大麻烦，对我们后续行事不利。”
阿萝用力点头，但眼中恨意难消：“我明白……可是……”
“所以，我们要用别的方法。”秦夜眼中寒光一闪，“他赖以横行、打死你爹的，是他那身淬体四重的修为，和那双沾满血的手。废了他的修为，断了他作恶的依仗，让他后半生活在恐惧和痛苦里，比一刀杀了他，更解恨，也更……安全。”
阿萝怔住了。废了修为？对于一个武者，尤其是一个依仗武力作恶的护卫头目来说，失去修为，恐怕比死更难受。而且，不会立刻引来官府最激烈的追查。
“可……可他淬体四重，秦大哥你……”阿萝担心地看着秦夜。她知道秦夜厉害，能救她，能废赵阔，但刀疤刘是淬体四重，而且是经常与人搏杀的老手，不是赵阔那种纨绔可比的。
“淬体四重而已。”秦夜语气淡然，带着一种理所当然的自信，“我自有办法。你现在要做的，是配合我完成第二次治疗，并开始学习最基础的吐纳法门。你的身体需要尽快产生气感，才能更好地吸收药力，修复经脉。”
阿萝压下心中的担忧和恨意，重重地点了点头：“我听秦大哥的！”
接下来的几个时辰，秦夜先为阿萝进行了第二次治疗。这一次，不再是刮骨疗毒般的粗暴驱逐，而是更精细的引导和修复。他用新买的银针，配合自身增长了不少的真气，以及一颗淬体丹化开的药力，一点点疏通阿萝腿部受损、淤塞的细微经脉，刺激断骨处的生机，促进愈合。
过程依旧痛苦，但阿萝咬牙硬撑，一声不吭，额头上冷汗涔涔，嘴唇都咬出了血。她能清晰地感觉到，有一股温和却坚韧的力量，随着银针的刺入，在她伤腿里游走，所过之处，那种刺痛和麻木感逐渐被一种酸胀和微热取代，仿佛干涸的土地得到了雨水的滋润。
治疗结束后，阿萝疲惫不堪，但精神却好了许多，伤腿的疼痛也减轻了大半，只剩下固定的酸胀。
秦夜没有让她休息，而是开始传授她最基础的吐纳法门——并非《九转生死诀》，而是一门前世他收集的、中正平和、最适合打基础、修复经脉的《养元诀》。这门功法进展缓慢，几乎没什么攻击力，但胜在稳当，对修复暗伤、固本培元有奇效，正适合阿萝现在的情况。
他讲解得很仔细，从呼吸节奏、意念引导，到气感初生时的种种感觉和注意事项，都一一说明。阿萝听得极为认真，不敢漏掉一个字。
“你现在经脉受损，感知微弱，可能很久都感觉不到‘气’的存在，不要急躁，不要强求。每天早晚，按照我教的方法，静心吐纳一个时辰。主要目的是让你熟悉这个过程，也让你的身体逐渐适应真气的滋养。”秦夜嘱咐道。
“我记住了，秦大哥。”阿萝郑重应下。
“我出去一趟，办点事。你留在这里，不要出去。如果有人来，躲到那个木架后面去，不要出声。”秦夜起身，从包裹里取出一个小瓷瓶，倒出两颗散发着清凉气味的药丸递给阿萝，“如果疼痛难忍，或者感觉发烧，就服下一颗。另一颗备用。”
“秦大哥，你……你要小心。”阿萝接过药丸，眼中满是担忧。
“嗯。”秦夜应了一声，检查了一下随身物品，尤其是那几根新买的银针，然后推开修好的木门，身影没入渐浓的暮色之中。
阿萝靠在干草铺上，手里紧紧攥着那两颗药丸，望着秦夜消失的方向，心中默默祈祷。
天色彻底黑透时，秦夜已经回到了青云城内。他换回了那套粗布短褐，脸上也重新做了伪装，看起来像个普通的脚夫或帮闲，混在入夜后依旧喧嚣的街市中。
快活林不在主街，而在城西一片杂乱拥挤的棚户区深处。这里没有百花楼的丝竹悦耳，只有赌徒的嘶吼、赢钱的狂笑、输钱的咒骂，以及暗巷里传来的暧昧调笑和女子的嗔怪。空气里混杂着汗味、劣质脂粉味、尿骚味和一种廉价的兴奋剂气味。
秦夜对这里的气味和混乱视若无睹，他像一条融入污水的鱼，悄无声息地穿过拥挤的人流和肮脏的巷道，目光锐利地扫过一个个赌档和昏暗的门廊。
很快，他在一个挂着“富贵赌坊”破旧牌子的门口，看到了目标。
content_en:
It was already afternoon when we returned to the mountain cabin. The wooden house was very quiet. A Luo was lying on the hay bed and seemed to be asleep. However, the slight sound of Qin Ye pushing the door open immediately made her open her eyes. Her eyes were alert. She didn't relax until she saw Qin Ye clearly, showing a trace of unnoticeable peace of mind.
"Brother Qin, you are back." She wanted to stand up.
"Lie down and don't move." Qin Ye handed over the buns and water bag in his hand, "Eat something first, something hot."
A'luo took it and bit into the still-warm bun, but her eyes kept looking at Qin Ye, as if she wanted to see something from his face.
Qin Ye sat down next to her and also took a bun to eat. While eating, he said, "I got some news. About Scar Liu and the city lord's mansion."
A Luo stopped chewing immediately and stared at Qin Ye.
"Scar Liu, whose real name is Liu San, is at the fourth level of body tempering. He is the captain of the third team of the City Lord's Mansion Guards. He is Zhao Gang's confidant and one of the most ferocious dogs under his command." Qin Ye spoke calmly, as if he was describing something that had nothing to do with him. "Today at noon, he, Wang Zhen, the son of a bookkeeper in the City Lord's Mansion, and several other dudes were drinking in Baihua Tower."
A Luo's hands shook slightly and the bun almost fell off. Baihua Building, it was a gold-selling den that a poor girl like her would never dare to imagine. And the enemy who killed her father was living and drinking there.
"I gave him a little trick, which made him feel uncomfortable for a while." Qin Ye continued, "By the way, I also listened to what they said. Su Qingxue framed me to cancel the marriage of the young sect leader of the Ziyang Sect because she thought the young sect leader was romantic. But she chose the wrong stepping stone. The young sect leader felt that she had used such underhanded tactics to cause him to lose face, and he was quite dissatisfied with the Su family."
A Luo was a little confused when she heard this. The discord between these high-ranking families was too far away from her. She only cared about one thing: "That... that Scar Liu..."
"He is not on duty tonight. According to those dandies, he likes to go to the 'Happy Forest' in the west of the city to gamble a bit and then spend the night with a prostitute." Qin Ye finished the last bite of the bun and wiped his hands. "Happy Forest is a mixed bag of good and bad. It is a place where people from all walks of life gather in the city. It is also the place where people like him feel most comfortable."
A'luo's heart jumped suddenly and her breathing became rapid: "Brother Qin, you...you want to go find him?"
"Yes." Qin Ye nodded and looked at her, "Aluo, remember, revenge is not based on a moment of blood. You have to find the right time and use the right method. Scar Liu is from the City Lord's Mansion and has a backer in Qingyun City. Killing him blatantly will cause big trouble and be detrimental to our subsequent actions."
A Luo nodded vigorously, but the hatred in her eyes could not go away: "I understand...but..."
"So, we have to use other methods." A cold light flashed in Qin Ye's eyes. "What he relied on to run rampant and kill your father was his fourth-level cultivation of body tempering and his hands stained with blood. Destroying his cultivation, cutting off his reliance for evil, and letting him live in fear and pain for the rest of his life, it is more relieving than killing him with a knife, and it is more... safer."
A Luo was stunned. Abandoned cultivation? For a warrior, especially a guard leader who relies on force to commit evil, losing his cultivation is probably more painful than death. Moreover, it will not immediately lead to the most intense investigation by the government.
"But...but he is at the fourth level of body tempering. Brother Qin, you..." A Luo looked at Qin Ye worriedly. She knew that Qin Ye was powerful and could save her and defeat Zhao Kuo, but Scar Liu was at the fourth level of body tempering and was a veteran who often fought with others. He was not comparable to a playboy like Zhao Kuo.
"It's only the fourth level of body tempering." Qin Ye said calmly, with a sense of natural confidence, "I have my own way. What you have to do now is to cooperate with me to complete the second treatment and start learning the most basic breathing method. Your body needs to generate Qi as soon as possible so that it can better absorb the power of the medicine and repair the meridians."
A Luo suppressed the worry and hatred in her heart and nodded heavily: "I listen to Brother Qin!"
In the next few hours, Qin Ye first treated A Luo for the second time. This time, it is no longer a rough expulsion like scraping bones to cure poison, but more refined guidance and repair. He used the newly purchased silver needles, combined with his own infuriating energy, and the medicinal power of a body tempering pill, to gradually clear the damaged and clogged meridians in A Luo's legs, stimulate the vitality of the broken bones, and promote healing.
The process was still painful, but A Luo gritted her teeth and held on without saying a word. Cold sweat dripped from her forehead and her lips were bleeding. She could clearly feel that there was a gentle but tough force moving in her injured leg as the silver needle penetrated. Wherever it passed, the tingling and numbness was gradually replaced by a sense of soreness and slight heat, as if the dry land had been moistened by rain.
After the treatment, Ah Luo was exhausted, but her spirits improved a lot, and the pain in her injured leg was reduced by most, leaving only fixed soreness.
Qin Ye did not let her rest, but began to teach her the most basic breathing method - not the "Nine Transformations of Life and Death", but the "Yuan Yuan Jue" that he had collected in his previous life, which was righteous and peaceful, and was most suitable for laying the foundation and repairing the meridians. This technique progresses slowly and has almost no attack power, but it is more reliable than anything else. It is very effective in repairing hidden injuries and strengthening the body, which is suitable for A Luo's current situation.
He explained it very carefully, explaining everything from the breathing rhythm, the guidance of thoughts, to the various feelings and precautions when the Qi is first generated. A Luo listened extremely carefully and did not dare to miss a word.
"Now that your meridians are damaged and your senses are weak, you may not be able to feel the existence of 'qi' for a long time. Don't be impatient and don't force it. Every morning and evening, follow the method I teach and breathe quietly for an hour. The main purpose is to familiarize you with this process and let your body gradually adapt to the nourishment of true qi." Qin Ye instructed.
"I remember, Brother Qin." A Luo solemnly agreed.
"I'm going out to do some errands. You stay here and don't go out. If anyone comes, hide behind the wooden frame and don't make a sound." Qin Ye stood up, took out a small porcelain bottle from the package, poured out two pills with a cool smell and handed them to A Luo, "If the pain is unbearable, or you feel feverish, take one. The other one is reserved."
"Brother Qin, you...you have to be careful." A Luo took the pills, her eyes full of worry.
"Yes." Qin Ye responded, checked his belongings, especially the newly purchased silver needles, then pushed open the repaired wooden door and disappeared into the growing dusk.
Ah Luo leaned on the hay bed, clutching the two pills tightly in her hands, looking at the direction where Qin Ye disappeared, praying silently in her heart.
------
When the sky turned completely dark, Qin Ye had already returned to Qingyun City. He changed back into the short brown suit of coarse cloth, and re-disguised his face. He looked like an ordinary porter or helper, blending into the still noisy market after dark.
Happy Forest is not on the main street, but deep in a chaotic and crowded shanty town in the west of the city. There is no sweetness like the silk and bamboo of Baihua Tower here, only the roars of gamblers, the wild laughter of winning money, the cursing of losing money, as well as the ambiguous teasing and women's blame coming from the dark alley. The air was mixed with the smell of sweat, low-quality powder, urine, and a cheap stimulant smell.
Qin Ye turned a blind eye to the smell and chaos here. Like a fish melting into the sewage, he silently passed through the crowded crowds and dirty alleys, scanning the gambling stalls and dim doorways with sharp eyes.
Soon, he saw his target at a door with a shabby sign that read "Wealthy Gambling House".
